1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is a light-activated microtransponder.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and wherein the test tube is formed from a material selected to preserve biological or chemical samples.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term storage of biological samples.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polymer is selected to withstand storage at temperatures of -20°C or lower.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system is configured to track and manage sample data using the embedded MTP.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the system is adapted for low temperature operation such that the racks and test tubes are handled and stored at -20°C or less, and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer of the test tube maintains structural integrity at such temperatures.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating a light-activated microtransponder to above the melting point of a plastic material; and melting a portion of the plastic material with the heated microtransponder to embed the microtransponder within the plastic.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a test tube assembly with an embedded light-activated microtransponder; and reading the microtransponder using a light-activated reader.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein the vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polymer is selected to withstand storage at temperatures of -20°C or lower.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
